# 3 bed penthouse for sale

> DNG is delighted to present this exceptional, three-bedroom corner penthouse apartment to the market. Spanning approximately 115 sq m (1,238 sq ft), this residence boasts a predominantly southerly orientation with views overlooking the grounds of Castleknock College. The property is presented in excellent condition, featuring a high standard of finish throughout.

## Fakta
- Typ: penthouse
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 115 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C1
- Lokalita: 46 Kavanagh Hall, Collegewood, Castleknock
- Cena: 525 000 €
